verdict: Paid leads hold steady; Google Business drop and pipeline gap need attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 129 leads from Meta at a cost per lead of $11.47 — paid performance is essentially flat week over week, with efficiency holding. The concern this period sits outside paid ads: Google Business Profile actions fell 47% in the most recent week and recorded zero actions on each of the last two days, which is not a seasonal pattern. Separately, of the 129 leads that arrived, only 76 entered your pipeline — the remaining 53+ did not progress, pointing to an intake gap rather than an advertising issue. We're actively addressing both the Google Business drop and the pipeline routing to make sure leads move correctly from first contact to booked appointment.
